competitor_alerts: NEW COMPETITOR: Shi-Ya Modern Asian Cuisine, a kosher sushi concept, opened June 30, 2026 at 7114 Campbell Road inside Meat Point. It earned Dallas Observer coverage in the 'June restaurant openings' roundup — that press link is exactly the kind of local backlink THR has none of.

Meat Point (meatpointdallas.com) now ranks on page 1 for 'Shabbat meals Dallas' on the strength of a Friday hot-meal takeout menu. THR sells a weekly Shabbat Box and does not rank at all for that term — this is the single biggest head-to-head loss this week.

Simcha Kosher Catering's YELP PAGE (11 reviews) outranks THR for 'kosher catering Dallas'. THR did not surface a Yelp listing in any of the seven searches run this week, including the Yelp-restricted 'kosher Dallas site:yelp.com' query, where the top-10 list was Aderet, Meat Point, Milk and Honey, CCCP Market, Weinberger's, Cattleack, Tokyo Bar, Midtown Pizza, Deli News and Benny's Bagels. THR is absent from Yelp's kosher Dallas category entirely.

dallaskosher.org (the local VAAD directory) appears in the top 3 for five of the seven target keywords. THR does not appear on its /restaurants or /new-page-1 (catering) listings — the highest-authority local citation in this niche is missing a THR entry.

Delivery keywords are owned by aggregators: DoorDash, Uber Eats and Postmates take nearly all of page 1 for 'kosher delivery Dallas' and 'kosher meal delivery Texas'. THR's in-house-delivery-only model means it is invisible on the highest-intent delivery searches.

summary: The Hungry Rooster ranks on page 1 for only 2 of 7 target keywords this week — 'kosher catering Dallas' (~#10) and 'Jewish catering Dallas' (~#8) — and is absent for all food, restaurant, delivery and Shabbat terms. The biggest single problem is technical: the live /shabbat page is serving the homepage title and a canonical tag pointing at the homepage, with no crawlable menu content, even though the correct code already exists in the repo, which is almost certainly why competitor Meat Point ranks for 'Shabbat meals Dallas' and THR does not. Off-site, THR has no Yelp listing and no entry in the dallaskosher.org directory, the two properties that dominate these search results, while a new kosher competitor (Shi-Ya) opened in June and picked up Dallas Observer coverage.
